title: Pointer Arithmetic
instructions: An array's name is really a pointer to its first box. That means pointers and arrays are deeply connected.
If ptr points to the first number, then ptr + 1 points to the NEXT number, ptr + 2 the one after, and so on.
The pointer already knows how big each item is, so it jumps the right amount for you.
To read the value at ptr + 1, follow it with a star: *(ptr + 1).
task: Fill in the blank so it prints the SECOND number (20).
hint:
Move one step and follow it:

    *(ptr + 1)
